All — quick update after looking at the draft and talking with Product: the shift to a 4/24 canary start is workable. I sketched a short ramp & gate plan and a training outline below. Attaching briefs.

Canary (proposed):
- Day 0 (4/24 09:00 PST): Start 5% traffic to Maestro variant v1.2-Medfolio
- Gate 1 (24 hrs): error-rate < 0.5% and latency P95 < 420ms — proceed to 20%
- Gate 2 (48 hrs): error-rate < 0.25% and latency P95 < 400ms — proceed to 50%
- Gate 3 (72 hrs): sustained stability metrics and no critical regressions — schedule full ramp to 100% over 72 hrs, with an immediate rollback plan if any gate fails

Rollback triggers and responders: immediate rollback if high-severity errors > 0.5% or any data-exposure concern. Primary on-call: Jonas (eng), Secondary: Tessa (SE).

Training outline (attached training-outline.docx):
- Ops deep-dive (90m, afternoons PST) — runbook, monitoring dashboards, escalation playbook
- Dev integration (60m, mornings PST) — sample SDK calls, KV cache hints, quantization profile notes
- Runbook/drill (60m, afternoon) — simulated regression + rollback walkthrough

Attachments: canary-schedule-brief.pdf, training-outline.docx

I’ll update the MAP-v1.1 (add canary gates and training dates) once Jonas confirms the capacity side — tentative ETA for a revised MAP to customer: COB 3/17.

—Ben
